public44.interpretation: Separate unprofiled single runs against existing evidence; modest reduction, not a controlled speedup or the 20x target.

focusedOriginalC.scope: Original full-main worlds; native queue ordering/move/split/opaque union/ID wrap/growth and public property/spot/stats/sleep APIs, sterile and viable eggs with actual hostile/tame monster creation, native timed property scan and real POTION expiry, real burn/light expiry/cleanup, complete ordered RNG/state and terminal/frame equality. Actual nonempty timer save/release/restore/relink bytes and state checked. Fatal status and remaining foreign event branches need separate acceptance.

ordinaryTurns.scope: Real initial walk, wait and forced attack; input through pending output and next read. Generic C field access and pointer-table dispatch are also counted; C malloc includes this runtime's C-stack allocations. Counters are architectural acceptance, not CPU or timing samples.

limits: Zero generic bridge/field calls and C heap allocation acceptance remains false.
Fatal status and remaining foreign event branches remain separately unaccepted.
The queue and explicit serialization/addressable-local boundaries still use measured byte storage.
